missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Порог' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'мешает'. 'Высокий' is the agreeing masculine adjective describing it.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Порог' is the inanimate masculine accusative object of 'переступил', identical to its nominative form. 'Дома' is a genitive modifier.
Strategic focus: Genitive of location. 'Порога' is the genitive after 'у', meaning beside the threshold. The fixed final stress keeps the vowel through declension.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Порогу' is the dative after 'к', marking movement toward the threshold. A core motion-and-location pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'На пороге' uses the prepositional form 'пороге' after 'на' to show position on the threshold.
Strategic focus: Accusative with 'о'. 'Порог' is the accusative after 'о' meaning to trip against the threshold. The inanimate masculine accusative matches the nominative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of position. 'Порогом' is the instrumental after 'перед', meaning in front of the threshold. 'Коврик' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Пороги' is the nominative plural subject. 'Высокие' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'в домах' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Пороги' is the inanimate accusative plural object of 'покрасили', matching the nominative plural. 'Все' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Prepositional in commands. 'На пороге' is the prepositional location in the negated imperative. A natural everyday invitation to come inside.
